استفردوا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْرَدُوا (istafradū) /is.taf.ra.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْرَدَ (istafrada)
# اُسْتُفْرِدُوا (ustufridū) /us.tuf.ri.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْرَدَ (istafrada)
# اِسْتَفْرِدُوا (istafridū) /is.taf.ri.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْرَدَ (istafrada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
